name: shakedown
description: Shake down a PR, branch, spec or feature area in the running app, in phases on one tldraw doc: find every feature in scope, every way to prove each one works (create, update and delete included), and every way a user could make it misbehave, compile them into a scenario list for you to approve, then test each scenario in Chrome with a screenshot of every step and a read-only database check. Confirms failures on the base branch, leaves a failing browser test per bug, and posts the board and results as a PR comment. Report-only — never edits app code.
